resources.title: Mamba-3: Part 1
resources.notes: **Emerging.** New this pass — the named-but-unverified "Mamba-3" item, now confirmed and fully fetched. Primary-source post by one of Mamba's co-creators explaining Mamba-3's architectural changes over Mamba-2 (exponential-trapezoidal discretization, complex-valued/RoPE-style state rotation, MIMO SSMs, BCNorm, removal of the short conv) with concrete latency benchmarks (1.5B model, H100, batch 128: Mamba-3-SISO ≈140.6s vs. Mamba-2 ≈149.0s vs. vLLM/Llama-3.2-1B ≈976.5s at 16,384 tokens) and open-sourced kernels. Underlying paper is arXiv 2603.15569 (ICLR 2026 oral), March 2026 — extremely current; not yet broadly replicated outside the authors' own lab, hence "emerging" rather than "established."

resources.title: On-Policy Distillation
resources.type: Kevin Lu et al., Thinking Machines Lab
resources.notes: **Emerging.** Fetched; new post-training method (per-token reverse-KL distillation from a fixed teacher), reports beating RL at ~10x less compute on AIME'24; independently referenced by Qwen3 report but not yet broadly replicated outside a few labs. Published Oct 2025, within window.

resources.title: Native Sparse Attention: Hardware-Aligned and Natively Trainable Sparse Attention
resources.notes: **Emerging** (leaning established within DeepSeek's own lineage; not yet broadly replicated by other labs at scale). Feb 2025, ~21 months old — slightly outside strict 12-month window but surfaced directly during this research and still actively referenced.

resources.title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
resources.notes: **Established.** MLA + DeepSeekMoE + aux-loss-free load balancing + multi-token-prediction; now a widely replicated baseline architecture (per Raschka comparison, influences Kimi K2 and others). Dec 2024, outside strict 12-month window — included as essential background context rather than a "new" development.

resources.title: Nemotron-H: A Family of Accurate and Efficient Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Models
resources.type: Aaron Blakeman et al., NVIDIA (199 authors)
resources.notes: **Established** (within NVIDIA's own hybrid-Mamba lineage; feeds directly into the later Nemotron 3 / Nemotron 3 Ultra MoE-hybrid family). New this pass — the named-but-unverified "Nemotron hybrid Mamba-attention" item, now confirmed and fetched (abstract/summary level). 8B and 56B models (plus a 47B MiniPuzzle-compressed derivative at ~20% faster inference, comparable accuracy) reporting accuracy at/above similarly sized Transformer baselines (Qwen-2.5, Llama-3.1) with up to 3x faster inference; introduces an FP8 training recipe matching BF16. First submitted Apr 2025, revised Sept 2025 — just outside the strict 12-month window but included as directly relevant background, same treatment as DeepSeek-V3.

resources.title: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence
resources.notes: **Established** open model; the MuonClip optimizer technique (Muon + QK-Clip to control attention-logit growth, enabling a reported zero-loss-spike 15.5T-token pretraining run) is itself an emerging training technique. New this pass — the named-but-unverified "Kimi K2 technical report" item, now confirmed and fetched (abstract/summary level). 1.04T-parameter MoE, 32B activated; reports SWE-Bench Verified 65.8, AIME 2025 49.5, GPQA-Diamond 75.1 (non-thinking settings). v1 submitted Jul 2025, v2 revised Feb 2026.

resources.title: Jamba: A Hybrid Transformer-Mamba Language Model
resources.type: Opher Lieber et al., AI21 Labs (22 authors)
resources.notes: **Established** — foundational hybrid Transformer-Mamba-MoE architecture (interleaved Transformer/Mamba blocks with MoE layers), predates and underlies later hybrids such as Nemotron-H; fits in a single 80GB GPU, up to 256K-token context. New this pass; fetched (abstract/summary level). Mar 2024 — now ~2.5 years old, included as background lineage rather than a "new" development, same treatment as DeepSeek-V3/Jamba-adjacent entries above.

resources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report
